decisions.reason: Having survived its first review and fitting the firm's specialist, high-reliability engineering niche, this naval vessel lighting line would likely be retained while management continues to learn from long-cycle customer demand unless results fall clearly below aspiration.

As a flagship product closely tied to the firm's strategic direction in efficient and intelligent lighting, it is very unlikely to be withdrawn unless performance becomes distinctly disappointing relative to expectations.

Because the firm already pruned a related marine searchlight offer and kept this one, management would usually interpret that as acceptable relative performance and continue with the line unless the marine niche weakens further.
